description: Kansas weatherization provides approved home energy improvements at no charge to eligible households. Apply through the provider serving your county.
introduction: Kansas weatherization provides approved home energy improvements at no charge to eligible households. Apply through the provider serving your county.

sections.who: Income-eligible renters and homeowners can apply. Current KHRC guidance identifies SSI, TANF or LIEAP receipt as an income-eligibility pathway. The home must meet property conditions too.
sections.get: An energy audit identifies efficiency and safety measures. Approved work is performed through the program’s auditors and contractors.
sections.docs: Prepare household income or qualifying-benefit evidence and property information. Disclose prior weatherization and ask about landlord permission for a rental.
sections.apply:
1. Use KHRC’s current provider map and contact the county’s weatherization provider.

  2. Complete screening and arrange the energy assessment. The linked standardized application describes occupancy, active utilities and prior-weatherization conditions.
sections.after: Confirm approved work, scheduling and contractor access with the provider. Keep completion paperwork and instructions for maintaining installed equipment.
sections.sources:
Application and program details: Program and county provider map, Standardized application and property screening.

Historical screenshots and background: USA Assistance. Screenshots may show an earlier application interface.

faqs: Yes. Ask the provider about landlord approval and property requirements.
Are services free for eligible households?
KHRC describes approved services and upgrades as free.
Does receiving LIEAP help with income eligibility?
KHRC lists LIEAP as a qualifying income pathway. Other screening still applies.
Can a previously weatherized home qualify?
The application has prior-weatherization restrictions; give the provider the date and circumstances.
